theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ Z₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ), MeasurableSet Z₀ ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) Z₀ = 0 ∧ ∃ (G : ℕ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (c : ℕ → Rn n) (r σ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ (∀ k, 0 < r k) ∧ (∀ k, 0 < σ k) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ b ∈ ball (c k) (r k), Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (G k) b)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ b₁ ∈ ball (c k) (r k), ∀ b₂ ∈ ball (c k) (r k), σ k * ‖b₁ - b₂‖ ≤ ‖G k b₁ - G k b₂‖) ∧ M ⊆ Z₀ ∪ ⋃ k, G k '' ball (c k) (r k)
